messages:
harry: Short follow-up from today's AH Q&A — recording is great but putting the concrete asks here so nobody has to hunt. Main clarifications folks asked for: 1) precise roadmap timing for the "Optimize" features that Ana mentioned; 2) who owns the release notes + customer-facing FAQ; 3) who's triaging any eval regressions flagged after the rollout.

ana: Quick clarify: Optimize (batching suggestions, quantization recommender) is slated for a staged release: internal beta mid-August, public beta late-August, GA end of September. We'll publish a timeline doc next Tue with exact dates.

selena: I'll own the release notes + FAQ. Plan to draft a customer-facing one-pager and an expanded engineering release note. Will post PR in docs repo by next Wed. Please ping me if you want specific examples or migration notes included.

mike: For eval regressions, the plan is: product-triage (me) gets the initial signal from the quality monitor, then route to the model-ops or infra owners depending on root cause. I'll make a short runbook for triage steps and thresholds.

elaine: Quick comms note: Marketing needs the public beta blurb by Aug 10 to hit the newsletter schedule. Selena, can you share the FAQ draft by then? Also we discussed a short demo webinar for partners at beta start — volunteer hosts?

selena: Yes — share by Aug 8 so we have time to iterate. I can host the partner webinar with someone from product. Harry, you down to co-host?

harry: Yep happy to co-host the webinar. I'll prepare a short roadmap slide and a demo script.

mike: Draft triage runbook items I'll include:
```
- step 1: check eval dashboard for metric delta > 3 sigma
- step 2: run regression repro notebook in sandbox
- step 3: tag model-ops (channel #eng-ml) and infra if latency regressions
```
I'll post the runbook link by Mon.

deploy-bot: Notice: roadmap page updated by ana 1h ago  changelog: "Optimize staging dates added"

harry: Action items summary (owners):
- ana: publish timing doc for Optimize staging + GA by Tue (owner: ana)
- selena: release notes + FAQ draft by Aug 8 (owner: selena)
- mike: triage runbook + initial thresholds by Mon (owner: mike)
- elaine: schedule partner webinar and confirm co-hosts by Aug 12 (owner: elaine)
I'll convert these into tickets and ping owners. If anyone else wants to be CC'd on the webinar thread add yourself here. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
